probes.name: sheet_name_00
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
ws.Name = ""
Probe = Err.Number & "|" & (ws.Name = "")
End Function

probes.name: range_call_one
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
Probe = ws.Range("B2:C3")(1).Address & "|" & ws.Range("B2:C3")(4).Address & "|" & ws.Range("B2:C3")(5).Address
End Function

probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String

Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next

probes.name: value_of_empty_cells
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
Dim v
v = ws.Range("A1:B2").Value
Probe = TypeName(v) & "|" & UBound(v, 1) & UBound(v, 2) & "|" & IsEmpty(v(2, 2))
End Function

probes.name: value_past_used_cells
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
Dim v
v = ws.Range("A1:C3").Value
Probe = UBound(v, 1) & UBound(v, 2) & "|" & v(1, 1) & "|" & IsEmpty(v(3, 3)) & "|" & UBound(ws.Range("D5:E6").Value, 1)
End Function

probes.name: value_error_cells
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=1/0"
ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=NA()"
Dim v
v = ws.Range("A1:A2").Value
Probe = IsError(v(1, 1)) & "|" & CStr(v(1, 1)) & "|" & (v(2, 1) = CVErr(xlErrNA)) & "|" & ws.Range("A1").Text
End Function

probes.name: match_not_found
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = 1
Dim v
v = Application.Match("zz", ws.Range("A1:A3"), 0)
Probe = IsError(v) & "|" & (v = CVErr(xlErrNA)) & "|" & TypeName(v)
End Function
